MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
The lecture discusses topological constraint theory in glass science, focusing on the mean coordination number (MCN) and its relation to glass stability. MCN is a weighted average of the coordination numbers of constituent atoms.
